And the guilt… I kept believing I’d messed up clients’ taxes, even when I hadn’t. I even filled a bottle with pills one night, though I didn’t go through with it.  

Then, about three weeks ago, it shifted. I’m not sure how to describe it—restless, maybe. I can’t sit still. My husband says I snap over little things, like if the silverware’s not lined up in the drawer. I notice every little noise—the AC kicking on, the neighbor’s dog. I feel like I *have* to move, to organize, to fix things, but I don’t finish any of it. I’m not sleeping much, but I’m not tired either.  

I don’t know if this is stress, or hormones, or something worse. I’ve always been intense, but this feels different. I can’t tell if it’s coming from nowhere or if it’s been building for years.
